xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5398: pan open opens a phantom deck for projects whose key differs from their name (overdeck, DFAI, PrimalRoll, Orbacade, T2O-OSDP)

plan.title: pan open opens a phantom deck for projects whose key differs from their name (overdeck, DFAI, PrimalRoll, Orbacade, T2O-OSDP)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The dashboard keys every deck by the project's display name (name ?? key), but the open-path resolution from POST /api/ui/open carries only the registered key (UiOpenResolution.projectKey). openPathInDeck and the /open link host use that key as the deck key, so for the 5 projects whose key differs from their name (panopticon-cli/overdeck, primalroll/PrimalRoll, orbacade/Orbacade, dfai/DFAI, t2o-osdp/T2O-OSDP) pan open opens the path in an empty phantom deck named after the key, and the CLI prints the key instead of the project's name.
narratives.Proposal: Add a required deckKey field to UiOpenResolution, which the server sets to projectDeckKey(registeredProject) = name ?? key for the project whose key equals root.projectKey; projectKey and rootId keep the registered key. openPathInDeck uses resolution.deckKey for every deck call, the /open host redirects to /command-deck/<deckKey>, and the CLI line and the dashboard toast both use a shared uiOpenSummary(resolution) sentence that names the project by display name and an issue workspace by its issue id. projectsData.ts switches to the same projectDeckKey helper so the switcher and the resolver share one rule. Docs and a changelog entry describe the change. Full detail, before/after snippets and decisions D-1..D-8 are in .pan/drafts/pan-5398.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The no-root error sentence (`<path> is inside <project> but not in a feature or scratch workspace`) keeps naming the registered key in the CLI and the /open toast; only the success line changes.
- No migration or cleanup of existing phantom decks in localStorage (e.g. pan-panes:panopticon-cli).
- No change to how decks are keyed (they stay keyed by display name) or to explorer root ids (they stay keyed by registered key: project:<key>, issue:<ID>, workspace:<id>).
- No change to resolvePathRoot, resolveExplorerRoot, the UI command hub, the leader-tab logic, or the outside-projects flow.
- No new HTTP route, RPC method, or stored state.
- No static value import of @overdeck/contracts added to src/cli/commands/open.ts (it stays lazy).

autoDecisions.summary: The server computes deckKey as name ?? key for the registered project whose key equals root.projectKey, falling back to root.projectKey when none matches.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Decision 1 prescribes this; root.projectKey is always the registered key, while resolvePathRoot's hit.projectKey can be '' for a scratch workspace outside every project.

autoDecisions.summary: A shared pure projectDeckKey(project) helper in packages/contracts/src/ui-commands.ts is used by both the server and the frontend fetchProjects, with the ?? rule (not ||).
autoDecisions.rationale: The bug is two places disagreeing about the deck key; one function used by both removes the chance of drift, and ?? matches today's switcher behaviour exactly.

autoDecisions.summary: The success sentence is derived from the resolution by a shared uiOpenSummary helper: relPath → 'Opened <relPath> in <deckKey>'; empty relPath with an issue:<ID> root → 'Opened the <ID> workspace in <deckKey>'; else 'Opened root folder in <deckKey>'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The toast never sees the CLI's parsed target, so deriving the issue case from rootId is the only way the CLI and the toast print the same text, which the issue requires.

autoDecisions.summary: The dashboard toast becomes exactly the CLI sentence and drops the 'from pan open' suffix.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says the toast says the same; the /open link uses the same toast, where 'from pan open' was already inaccurate.

autoDecisions.summary: The CLI falls back to projectKey when the dashboard response has no deckKey.
autoDecisions.rationale: A newer CLI may talk to an older running dashboard; the frontend needs no fallback because the server serves its own bundle.

autoDecisions.summary: The no-root error message is left unchanged and listed in NonGoals.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue scopes the wording change to the success line; widening it would add untested surface without an operator ask.

autoDecisions.summary: OpenPathHost's URL redirect to /command-deck/<deckKey> is included although the issue's list of deck calls omits it.
autoDecisions.rationale: App.tsx handleSelectProject writes /command-deck/<projectName>, so the URL segment is the deck name; without this, the /open link and pan open --new-tab still land on the phantom deck.

metadata.sizeJustification: Small surface: 13 files across contracts, one server route, three frontend modules, one CLI command, and docs.

items.title: UiOpenResolution carries deckKey, filled by POST /api/ui/open, plus projectDeckKey and uiOpenSummary helpers

expected_outputs: ui-commands.test.ts and ui-open.test.ts pass, including the panopticon-cli/overdeck case

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/pan-5398.md). In packages/contracts/src/ui-commands.ts add `deckKey: Schema.String` to UiOpenResolution directly after projectKey (with doc comments), and add the pure exports `projectDeckKey(project: { readonly key: string; readonly name?: string | null }): string` (returns project.name ?? project.key) and `uiOpenSummary(resolution: Pick<UiOpenResolution, 'deckKey' | 'rootId' | 'relPath'>): string` (relPath non-empty → `Opened ${relPath} in ${deckKey}`; relPath '' and rootId starting 'issue:' → `Opened the ${id} workspace in ${deckKey}`; else `Opened root folder in ${deckKey}`). Add packages/contracts/src/__tests__/ui-commands.test.ts with the cases in PRD WI-1 step 3. In src/dashboard/server/routes/ui-open.ts widen UiOpenDeps.listProjects to `{ key; name?; path }`, map `name: p.config.name` in defaultDeps, keep the raw project rows (projectRows) alongside the realpath-filtered ones, and set `deckKey: registered ? projectDeckKey(registered) : root.projectKey` where `registered = projectRows.find((p) => p.key === root.projectKey)`. Do not change projectKey, rootId, or the no-root/outside-projects bodies. Update the exact toEqual at ui-open.test.ts line 40 to include deckKey: 'demo' and add the two new tests from PRD WI-1 step 5.
